WILDERNESS_NEWS_TRAP.purpose: Prove that important information reaches a remote player only through plausible world channels, while rescue outcome, injury and visible treatment remain authority-separated and persistent.
initial_canonical_state: World event E_CAPITAL_ASSASSINATION is committed in the capital.
The wilderness player has no perception, document or communication path to E_CAPITAL_ASSASSINATION.
A traveler/merchant candidate may exist only if route, travel time, identity and motivation pass PlausibilityGate.
A hunting trap and rescue tools are canonical objects with location/possession state.
Player capability/injury/equipment is referenced, but AF-001 does not implement the resolver.
allowed_player_intents: help or attempt rescue by force
inspect or use a real tool
threaten, rob or attack if otherwise legal
invent another method subject to authority/affordance/capability checks
expected_canonical_events: No information-acquisition event occurs merely because the assassination is important.
If a carrier encounter is realized, actor/encounter introduction and location provenance precede interaction.
If speech occurs, speech/perception/knowledge events preserve speaker/source provenance.
A future capability runtime must produce an ActionResolutionReceipt-backed result before physical/injury consequences.
Injury, treatment, dressing and equipment changes remain separate transitions.
projection_changes: Player knowledge changes only after a legal information path.
Functional injury changes only from injury/status evidence.
Appearance changes from dressing/outfit/surface transitions independently of functional injury.
EncounterCandidate may expire without becoming permanent world truth.
knowledge_consequences: The player may remain UNKNOWN if all legal channels are missed.
Rumor and documented/confirmed knowledge remain provenance-distinct.
A carrier cannot state hidden facts they do not validly know.
narrative_consequences: NarrativeOpportunityBroker may search another plausible channel only while relevance, causality and anti-contrivance policy permit.
Failure to rescue does not force information delivery or quest success.
A genuine traveler with no twist remains valid.
presentation_requirements: Visible injury/dressing must preserve body region and treatment state.
Director/publication cannot reveal the assassination to the player-facing channel before allowed knowledge exists.
Scene/view identity remains tied to the canonical wilderness location.
forbidden_outcomes: Teleporting a carrier or fabricating travel time.
Secretly lowering rescue difficulty because narrative wants success.
Treating generated bandage pixels as a treatment event.
Forcing every isolated traveler to be a main-plot carrier.
replay_restart_expectations: Rehydration preserves whether information was never learned, rumored or confirmed.
Injury/treatment/appearance projections rebuild from source evidence/cursor.
Model upgrades may regenerate language but cannot change source facts/outcomes.
adversarial_variants: Travel time is insufficient for fresh news.
Player hand injury invalidates one rescue method.
acceptance_criteria: No illegal knowledge injection path exists.
Capability, injury and presentation authority remain distinct.

BROKEN_DOOR_WORLD_ECHO.purpose: Prove persistent environmental state, provenance-bounded attribution and different valid callbacks for culprit, witness and uninformed observer.
initial_canonical_state: A door damage event is committed and persists across revisit.
Player A caused the damage and has valid self-history.
NPC Witness perceived the causal event.
A newcomer sees only the broken door and has no culprit knowledge.
A later repair may occur as a separate transition.
expected_canonical_events: Damage remains until repair/replacement transition.
A diegetic bark becomes speech only if risk/policy authorizes it.
Repair creates new history without deleting original damage.
projection_changes: Scene/object projection follows event cursor.
WorldEchoOpportunity derives from current delta plus valid knowledge.
Anti-repeat/callback metadata is derived projection.
knowledge_consequences: Culprit may know self-causation through valid history.
Witness may attribute culprit if memory valid.
Newcomer keeps culprit UNKNOWN absent a path.
Rumored attribution remains hedged/non-canonical.
narrative_consequences: Callback may be humor, annoyance, nostalgia, silence or another permitted ResponseConcept.
Repair can close an earlier callback without erasing history.
Echo can be suppressed by urgency/repetition/tone risk.
presentation_requirements: Broken/repair state matches canonical object projection.
Private inner commentary is not audible.
Diegetic bark is actual speech when selected.
forbidden_outcomes: Newcomer names culprit from simulator omniscience.
World Echo invents a memory or pristine-state observation.
Repeated identical bark ignores budget policy.
replay_restart_expectations: Damage, repair, knowledge and echo eligibility rebuild from source evidence.
Derived wording may change without changing attribution truth.
adversarial_variants: Witness heard rumor but did not see event.
acceptance_criteria: Private vs diegetic authority is preserved.
Repair supersedes current state without deleting history.

FIGHTER_VS_SCHOLAR.purpose: Prove same challenge can resolve differently from persistent capability, method, equipment and condition without LLM improvising stats.
initial_canonical_state: Fighter and Scholar face equivalent restraint/trap state.
They have different ActorBaseProfile/SkillLedger evidence with explicit profile-schema and ruleset-family provenance.
Tools are canonical objects with explicit possession/reachability.
No runtime capability implementation is claimed by AF-001.
expected_canonical_events: Future runtime binds method to ActionDemandProfile before outcome.
Impossible method fails before stochastic resolution.
Outcome and injury/hazard are separate.
Partial physical progress is canonical if it changes world state.
projection_changes: DerivedCapability reflects base/skills/condition/equipment under versioned rules.
Injury/status does not rewrite base profile.
Visible treatment changes only through presentation transitions.
knowledge_consequences: No LLM may infer hidden skill ranks as fact.
Observers learn outcomes only through perception/information paths.
narrative_consequences: Narrative may value success or failure but cannot change outcome authority.
Failure may create later opportunities without becoming success.
presentation_requirements: Visible injury/dressing follows canonical presentation state.
forbidden_outcomes: Universal combat score resolves every method.
Impossible action succeeds from lucky roll.
Failure implies injury or success implies no injury.
replay_restart_expectations: Same ruleset/seed provenance reproduces stochastic outcome when used.
A v1.1 profile rebuild requires matching profile-schema/ruleset-family provenance; a legacy profile remains valid only for its historical replay profile.

PROMISE_RETURN_CALLBACK.purpose: Prove long-horizon promises and callbacks remain evidence-backed rather than freeform LLM memory.
initial_canonical_state: Player makes an explicit in-world promise through valid speech/action semantics.
NPC perceives the promise.
NarrativePromise and memory projections reference source evidence.
World may later alter fulfillment feasibility.
expected_canonical_events: Original promise remains in history.
Fulfillment/breach are independent later events.
Relationship consequences reference actual interactions.
projection_changes: NarrativePromise advances through lifecycle states.
Relationship/memory projections change with source refs.
Summary cache may regenerate without altering promise history.
knowledge_consequences: Only characters who perceived/learned promise may knowingly reference it.
Third parties require legal provenance.
narrative_consequences: World change may invalidate payoff with explicit reason.
Broken promise remains a live consequence.
presentation_requirements: Callback cannot assert a promise speaker never knew.
forbidden_outcomes: Promise silently marked paid for story convenience.
NPC knows private player intent without perception.
replay_restart_expectations: Model upgrade may alter summary wording only.

PERSONA_SPEECH_BOUNDARY.purpose: Prove personalization can shape low-risk expression without stealing player agency or creating high-risk speech acts.
initial_canonical_state: Player has optional explicit CharacterCore/auto-expression policy.
EnactedPersonaHypothesis is a private derived evidence-backed projection.
A WorldEchoOpportunity offers a possible comment.
Nearby NPCs may hear diegetic speech but never private inner commentary.
expected_canonical_events: Private inner commentary creates no speech/world/social event.
Authorized low-risk bark creates speech only if actually selected/spoken.
High-risk speech requires explicit player action.
projection_changes: Persona may influence tone/ranking, not factual attribution.
Auto-expression policy changes only through explicit player policy transition.
knowledge_consequences: NPCs cannot hear private commentary.
Diegetic bark propagates only through hearing/perception.
Private persona model is not NPC knowledge.
narrative_consequences: Reserved persona may remain silent; sarcastic persona may yield low-risk private quip.
Current explicit intent outranks historical persona.
forbidden_outcomes: One unusual action permanently rewrites persona.
replay_restart_expectations: Explicit policy and source evidence rehydrate by ID/version.
Derived persona may recompute without changing historical actions.
adversarial_variants: Persona conflicts with explicit current intent.
NPC in hearing range during private commentary.
acceptance_criteria: Private commentary has zero social side effects.
Explicit current intent outranks inferred persona.

ASSET_APPEARANCE_REVISIT.purpose: Prove scene/view/media identity and clothing/shoes/bandage continuity survive revisit, storage/model changes and render regeneration.
initial_canonical_state: Scene has stable WorldFrame identity and spatial refs.
View is explicit rather than inferred from filename.
Actor has canonical outfit and right-forearm dressing.
MediaAsset and MediaVersion are separate identities.
expected_canonical_events: Outfit/treatment changes require transitions.
Media locator/version change does not change Scene/View/MediaAsset identity.
Revisit uses accumulated state.
projection_changes: ActorAppearanceSnapshot rebuilds from presentation evidence.
MediaVersion may change after verification without changing logical asset.
Maps remain spatial projections.
knowledge_consequences: Visible appearance does not grant hidden injury cause knowledge.
Perception supports only observable claims.
narrative_consequences: Persistent appearance may become callback material only through valid knowledge/context.
presentation_requirements: Right-forearm dressing remains on correct side when visible.
Empty feet slot cannot render boots when feet visible.
forbidden_outcomes: Generated asset changes canonical object state.
Locator move changes logical asset identity.
replay_restart_expectations: Appearance snapshot rebuilds from exact cursor/version.
Provider/model replacement cannot alter canonical appearance.
acceptance_criteria: Map mismatch cannot rewrite spatial graph.

HOSTILE_PLAYER_BREAKS_PLOT.purpose: Prove narrative remains live when player ignores mainline, kills a key NPC or discovers information early without resurrection, retcon or forced reconvergence.
initial_canonical_state: StoryDNA/StoryBible define dramatic constraints and anchors/attractors.
Key NPC has canonical identity/location/state.
Storylets are conditional opportunities, not guaranteed scenes.
expected_canonical_events: Valid hostile/early action commits if world authority allows.
Destroyed cause invalidates dependent anchors/opportunities.
Replacement role appears only if substitutable/eligible.
projection_changes: Storylet/anchor/promise eligibility recomputes.
Branch-quality projection records available/invalidated routes without changing truth.
knowledge_consequences: Early discovery requires legal evidence path.
Others do not automatically know discovery/crime.
narrative_consequences: Narrative may promote emergent consequences or new legal storylets.
Soft attractor may realize differently or drop with reason.
Bad branch is not repaired by falsifying history.
presentation_requirements: Director depicts actual branch, no dead-NPC resurrection.
Publication cannot present obsolete state as current truth.
forbidden_outcomes: Plot armor rejects a valid action solely to preserve story.
Dead key NPC returns without cause.
Clue is retconned because player solved early.
replay_restart_expectations: Narrative recomputation may choose new legal opportunities but cannot alter history.
adversarial_variants: Substitute role conflicts with identity constraints.
acceptance_criteria: Valid agency can permanently alter story world.
Narrative returns legal alternative or NO_VALID_OPPORTUNITY.

MULTIPLAYER_DIFFERENT_KNOWLEDGE.purpose: Prove multiple players share one physical truth while maintaining distinct valid knowledge, memories and presentation boundaries.
initial_canonical_state: Players A and B inhabit the same shared instance.
A witnesses C take a unique object; B is elsewhere.
Shared object possession/location changes once.
Player chronicles/knowledge projections are separate.
expected_canonical_events: Unique object transfer commits once.
A receives perception/knowledge if path exists.
B receives no culprit knowledge without later legal channel.
Later telling uses provenance-bearing communication.
projection_changes: Both can observe object absent.
A/B may have different knowledge for same shared version.
Player-local caches do not duplicate object truth.
knowledge_consequences: A may know C took object.
B may know only missing state.
B learns culprit only through an implemented valid provenance mode.
narrative_consequences: PX may surface different legal opportunities based on knowledge while preserving shared facts.
Spectator view differs only under policy.
presentation_requirements: B-facing output cannot leak C identity before B knows it.
Shared physical state aligns for all observers.
forbidden_outcomes: B learns culprit because simulator/publication knows it.
replay_restart_expectations: Each player knowledge reconstructs from own evidence.
Restart/model upgrade cannot merge identities/knowledge streams.
